description: The enterprise edition: a Go core, its own PostgreSQL, audit logs, security configuration, user management, high availability.

machine.previousTitle: This machine has the previous enterprise edition
machine.openTitle: This machine runs the open edition
machine.previousNote: The enterprise edition is a separate installer now, and the previous one gets no more releases. The open part keeps upgrading with flocks update; the previous edition's audit logs, security configuration and user management pages come back with the new enterprise edition.
machine.openNote: The enterprise edition is a separate installer: it takes this install's data over (moved into its own PostgreSQL on its first start) and is used the same way. Contact us for a licence and the installer.

upgrade.title: Upgrade to the new enterprise edition
upgrade.whatChanges: After the upgrade the program is in {{root}}, the data stays where it is (moved into the bundled PostgreSQL on the first start; the original is kept) and the machine's licence is carried over; flocks start|stop|restart|status|logs|update work as before.
upgrade.systemd: systemd runs this machine (the open edition's offline package): the installer runs as root. The page can download it; then run the command it gives.
upgrade.prepare: {{account}} cannot write {{root}} yet: run this once as root, then come back.
upgrade.check: Check for the new enterprise edition
upgrade.manual: Copy the installer (flockspro-<version>-<platform>.run) to this machine and run, as {{account}}:

progress.installing: The installer runs ({{version}}): the open edition stops first, and the enterprise edition's first start moves the data, which can take a few minutes. This page reloads once it is done.
progress.restarting: The open edition has stopped and the enterprise edition is starting for the first time (moving the data). The page reloads if it listens on this address; otherwise open the address the installer printed.
progress.finished: The new enterprise edition {{version}} is installed; reload the page.
progress.failed: The install did not finish and the open edition keeps running; the installer output below says why.
progress.failedCode: The install did not finish (exit code {{code}}) and the open edition keeps running; the installer output below says why.
progress.command: The installer is downloaded. Run, as root:
progress.commandPrepare: The installer is downloaded. First let this account have the install directory (as root), then run the installer:
